The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
yang_dnode_get_ipv4p(&prefix, dnode, "./prefix");
yang_dnode_get_ipv4p(&p, dnode, NULL);
```
Reason:
The bug occurs because the code assumes that the northbound plugins will automatically apply the mask to the IPv4 prefixes retrieved by `yang_dnode_get_ipv4p()`. If the mask is not applied, it can lead to incorrect handling of the prefixes in subsequent operations, resulting in potential routing issues.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
apply_mask_ipv4(&prefix);
apply_mask_ipv4((struct prefix_ipv4 *)&p);
```
Reason:
The fix involves explicitly calling `apply_mask_ipv4()` on the prefixes after they are retrieved. This ensures that the correct mask is applied to the IPv4 prefixes before they are used in further processing, thus preventing the issues caused by the previous assumption.
